data.body: RCA / proof result: plan review passed and I ran the independent two-clone proof under the session artifact redstart-proof-repo. The proof exercised compact-all's snapshot_alpha path: base backfill selected 1 ticket; clone A alpha-selected and compacted after four A-tail comments; clone B alpha-selected and compacted after two B-tail comments; both clones then merged the combined tickets branch and rebar fsck reported 'no issues found' in both clones. The final normalized compiled states were equal, but the merged state had after_comments_have_a_tail=false, after_comments_have_b_tail=true, after_comment_count=10, and the script exited 2 with ANOMALY merged state lost a divergent tail. Interpretation: the later B snapshot superseded the A snapshot without containing A's tail, so equality after merge is a converged-loss state, not a safe reconvergence. This confirms an ADR 0118 safety anomaly; hammerkop must NOT enable snapshot_alpha yet.
